summary_ja: 重要な出資のうち十五パーセント基準額等を上回る部分のエクスポージャーに千二百五十パーセントのリスク・ウェイトを適用する。
summary_en: Applies a 1,250% risk weight to exposures to significant investments above the 15% and 60% threshold amounts.
paragraphs: Notwithstanding Articles 129 through the preceding Article, for an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach, the amount of credit risk-weighted assets for the exposure relating to the portion of significant investments, among covered investments, that exceeds the 15% threshold amount relating to significant investments shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the amount of that exposure (meaning EAD) by a risk weight of 1,250%.

In the case of the preceding paragraph, where the total amount of the portion of covered investments other than the portion corresponding to the amount to which a risk weight of 1,250% applies under that paragraph exceeds the 60% threshold amount relating to significant investments, the amount of credit risk-weighted assets for the exposure relating to the excess portion shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the amount of that exposure (meaning EAD) by a risk weight of 1,250%.
